column1: # Files from outside test suites that tools/modtest.py compiles when tools/fetch-testsuites.py
# has fetched them into testsuites/ (not in this repository): each reaches code of BCC.EXE
# the rest of the corpus does not, found by tracing Borland's compiler over every file of
# the suites; listed by what they add.  Many stop with errors in Borland C++ 2.0 (GCC
# extensions, templates, AT&T headers), which both compilers must report alike.  A .C file
# here is C++ (GCC's and cfront's convention), compiled as T.CPP.
# Left out: g++.other/bitfld3.C and g++.law/access4.C.  Borland's compiler writes output
# there that changes with the program's layout: a symbol name of leftover bytes (bitfld3,
# -S) and a different error message ("Compiler table limit exceeded in function {",
# access4).  Padding any one of five of eight groups of code blocks changes it, so it is no
# single address written as a number; probably memory the compiler never set up.
